name: What are the benefits of adding a mother-in-law suite to my home?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of adding a mother-in-law suite to my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adding a mother-in-law suite offers several advantages. It provides a private and independent living space for family members, allowing them to be close while maintaining autonomy. This can be beneficial for multi-generational living or caregiving. Additionally, an ADU can increase your property's value and provide a potential source of rental income if not used by family. It also offers flexibility for future use, such as a home office or guest quarters, enhancing the long-term utility of your property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Benefits include private living space for family, increased property value, potential rental income, and flexible use for guests or a home office.
